name: openrouter
title: OpenRouter
description: An OpenRouter API key. Funds any harness this box runs, and the embeddings the indexer needs.
setup:
Get an OpenRouter API key for this machine.
1. Open https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys and sign in (ask the person to sign in if needed — never create an account).
2. Create a key named "Flowpad" and copy it (it starts with `sk-or-`).
3. Store it: `flow credentials set openrouter OPENROUTER_API_KEY=<key>`.
4. Confirm with `flow credentials check openrouter`. Never print or repeat the key.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.label: API key
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.hint: Create one under Keys in your OpenRouter dashboard.
